title: Lorebook
dragHint: Drag to reorder. Earlier entries win when the prompt runs out of room.
emptyBody: An entry is a piece of the world and the words that bring it up.
noMatchBody: Titles, keywords and content are all searched.
titleHint: For you, the model never sees it
contentHint_one: {{count}} word. What the model learns when this fires
contentHint_other: {{count}} words. What the model learns when this fires
alwaysHint: Skip keywords; it is part of every reply
keywordsHint: Any of these in the conversation brings the entry in
keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
conflict: This lorebook changed while you were editing. Your draft is kept. Refresh its revision, review your draft, then save again.
patternsHint: One regular expression per row. Any match brings the entry in.
patternUnsupported: Lookarounds and backreferences are not supported
tryHint: Type a sentence to see which patterns match
secondaryPlaceholder: Optional. Type a keyword and press Enter

secondaryLogic.and_anyHint: Comes in only when one of these also appears. Leave empty for no condition.
secondaryLogic.and_allHint: Comes in only when every one of these also appears.
secondaryLogic.not_any: Must not have any of these
secondaryLogic.not_anyHint: Stays out when any of these appears.
secondaryLogic.not_all: Must not have all of these
secondaryLogic.not_allHint: Stays out only when all of these appear together.

keywordSyntax: Use (a|b) for options and * for any words in between, like (went|go) to the * bar.
